body: I wonder if its worth making `Field[T any]` to be able to `GetValue() T` here... but I'm thinking it might get too complicated for implementations that already use generics (e.g. selects) 🤔

This would be awesome, but since we use `fields []Field` in a group, all groups would have to instantiate the type argument to pass to the fields so each group would only be able to have one type for the fields and it would end up being `any` either way unfortunately.
